panels.headline: Bring your own sources
panels.body: Harbor connects to the addons you choose. It hosts nothing and ships no catalog of its own.
panels.credit: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920), public domain

panels.headline: Playback that respects the file
panels.body: A bundled mpv engine handles TrueHD, DTS-HD, AV1, odd containers and HDR without transcoding.
panels.credit: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920), public domain

panels.headline: Themes that go deep
panels.body: Restyle every surface, or install a community theme and make Harbor look like nothing else.
panels.credit: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari (1920), public domain

panels.headline: Watch together, actually together
panels.body: Synced playback with friends over your own relay, with no account required.

panels.headline: Anime, tracked properly
panels.body: Simkl and AniList stay in step with what you watch, episode by episode.

panels.headline: Your library, on every device
panels.body: Settings, addons and continue watching follow you between machines.
